name: magicglow
does: Her own magic glows as the creatures' spells do (the party start's ring, her blink, the ley line's spark and the other native effects: a bright core, a dithered halo, a pool of light on the ground, real lights); 0 draws it without the glow, as before, to compare.
decision: Glowing by default (Ed, 2026-11-13, asked whether to extend the creatures' glow to her magic: "extend")
